methods.name: private static long getMaxCachedBufferSize()
methods.comment:
* Returns the max size allowed for a cached temp buffers, in
     * bytes. It defaults to Long.MAX_VALUE. It can be set with the
     * jdk.nio.maxCachedBufferSize property. Even though
     * ByteBuffer.capacity() returns an int, we're using a long here
     * for potential future-proofing.

methods.name: private static boolean isBufferTooLarge(int size)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if a buffer of this size is too large to be
     * added to the buffer cache, false otherwise.

methods.name: private static boolean isBufferTooLarge(ByteBuffer buf)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the buffer is too large to be added to the
     * buffer cache, false otherwise.

methods.name: public static ByteBuffer getTemporaryDirectBuffer(int size)
methods.comment: * Returns a temporary buffer of at least the given size

methods.name: public static void releaseTemporaryDirectBuffer(ByteBuffer buf)
methods.comment: * Releases a temporary buffer by returning to the cache or freeing it.

methods.name: static void offerFirstTemporaryDirectBuffer(ByteBuffer buf)
methods.comment:
* Releases a temporary buffer by returning to the cache or freeing it. If
     * returning to the cache then insert it at the start so that it is
     * likely to be returned by a subsequent call to getTemporaryDirectBuffer.

methods.name: static void offerLastTemporaryDirectBuffer(ByteBuffer buf)
methods.comment:
* Releases a temporary buffer by returning to the cache or freeing it. If
     * returning to the cache then insert it at the end. This makes it
     * suitable for scatter/gather operations where the buffers are returned to
     * cache in same order that they were obtained.

methods.name: private static void free(ByteBuffer buf)
methods.comment: * Frees the memory for the given direct buffer
